question.text: 'Standardisation of Reporting Framework' is listed in Chapter 7.4 as a challenge because:

answer.text: There is only one global framework and it is mandatory
There is a plethora of international and national standards for social and environmental impact, often forcing organisations to publish multiple reports
SEBI does not permit any framework
The Government has abolished all frameworks

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 7.4 plainly states: 'With a plethora of international and national standards for social and environmental impact; organizations may find it difficult to use a standard format and may have to publish multiple reports depending on the frameworks it is adhering to.' The Trap: A is the opposite of truth. C and D are fabrications. Cross-Exam Context: Multi-framework pressure is also discussed in BRSR (Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report) under LODR Reg 34(2)(f) — III-A/III-C. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When scoping a multi-framework engagement, map each framework (GRI, SASB, BRSR, SAS) to a common indicator master and produce the SIR from one source. It eliminates reconciliation errors and halves the drafting time.
